content: The companion of true virtue is eternal honor.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
explanation: Wealth vanishes with inflation; physical youth wrinkles with the seasons; fame is as fickle as the wind. But a life lived with unwavering moral honor, justice, and courage casts a shadow that death itself cannot extinguish. Build a soul of honor.
practicalInsight: Choose the honorable course of action today, especially where cheating would be easy and undetectable.
reflectionPrompt: When your life is reviewed at the end of days, will it be defined by what you acquired, or by the honor with which you walked?
